quality.review_scope: Complete author text and actual visual reading of main pp.1–5 and SI pp.1–4; synthesis variants, electrode preparation, controls, structural results and electrochemical contexts retained. External full cited procedures and unprinted numerical curves excluded.
missing_fields: All five main and four SI pages were read as text and faithful page images; cited external full procedures remain outside the inspected local source.
Physical batch joins, unprinted curve values, atomic coordinates and unreported quantities are not reconstructed.
Source figures and qualified reference identities do not establish measured atomic geometry or training eligibility.
The reported 0.0756 mM polymer concentration has no specified molecular-weight or repeat-unit basis.
1000 mV is a two-electrode applied potential; no Ag/AgCl reference is asserted for EFDLA.
No quantitative QD bath concentration, complete alternating-bath sequence, bath volume or five-minute per-layer/per-cycle assignment is supplied.
conflicts: The main p.4 Methods list alternating immersion in 0.0756 mM polycation solutions and 0.5 M NaCl, whereas the labels and source schematic describe polycation/QD layers. The QD bath composition/concentration, NaCl bath assignment and exact immersion sequence are not fully specified; no bath recipe is silently repaired.

Main PDF p.2 reports ITO-(PMAEMA/QDs)6 height 183.5 nm and roughness 27.7 nm. SI PDF p.3 Table S2 reports height 158.9 ± 21.8 nm and roughness 20.6 ± 5.5 nm. Both contexts are retained without choosing one or asserting different measured batches.
